-84.95900,32.54080.name: Columbus Center for Reproductive Endocrinology & Infertility, LLC
-84.95900,32.54080.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Prakash J. Thiruppathi, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-48.43339,-22.07027.name: ALS Laboratórios Ltda (São Roque)
-48.43339,-22.07027.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of ALS Global. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-0.08800,51.50400.name: MHRA — Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway
-0.08800,51.50400.desc: A UK route intended to speed novel medicines to market through earlier and closer contact between developer and regulator. Routes of this kind trade certainty for speed, and for cell and gene therapies — where the evidence base is thin and the patient numbers small — that trade is made more often than anywhere else in medicine.

-0.09300,51.52200.name: Corporate registries — tracing an applicant
-0.09300,51.52200.desc: An application often arrives from a name with no history. A corporate registry gives the directors, the registered address, the accounts and, in many countries, the ultimate owner — free, immediately, no request needed. The UK register is fully open; most European ones are; the United States files at state level, so start with the state named on the application. The useful detail is usually the shared address or the shared director rather than the ownership chain, because a subsidiary set up for one trial tends to share both with its parent.
